props.Architecture: Radar owns chirp scheduling, R4F/C674x/HWA DSP, tracking, shot trigger and rolling history; the carrier host consumes compact packets.
props.Pinmux_contract: SPIA D2/F2/D1/C2 mode1; control V16 mode2/U16 mode5; telemetry E2 mode6; K3 hardware FRAME_START mode13; U12 SYNC_IN mode1; L3 SYNC_OUT mode2

props.Purpose: Remove for external UART probe; prevents host buffer contention

props.Boot_requirement: Program via SOP5 UARTA; verify NV SR.QE(bit6)=1 before quad boot; factory QE=0. Cold-boot qualify the assembled board.
